summary: First-iteration E2E testing of PPC Campaign Analytics dashboard. All 11 backend pytest tests pass (meta + analytics with/without filters). Frontend loads cleanly, all 5 KPIs render correct values (Campaigns=1,000; Avg ROAS=11.56; Avg CPC=$11.03; Revenue=$59.6M; Spend=$6.0M). All 6 tabs switch without errors. Filter bar works end-to-end: toggling Google platform reduced count from 1,000 → 800, Reset restored to 1,000. Insights panel shows 4 callout cards (Best Platform=Facebook, Region=North America, Age=25-34, Content=Video). No page errors. Editorial/Notion-style design renders correctly.

issues: Recharts console warnings 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' fire when tabs are inactive (hidden via display:none). Non-blocking but noisy. Consider mounting chart only when tab is active, or use min-h to keep container sized.

action_items: Optional: suppress recharts width(-1) warnings by lazy-mounting charts inside inactive Tabs (forceMount omitted / conditional render), or set a min-height on ResponsiveContainer parent.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py: data loaded synchronously at import time — acceptable for 1k-row dataset but startup will block on xlsx parsing; fine given constraints.

server.py: `safe_round` guards NaN/Inf well; however perf_stats uses .round(2) before safe_round so conversion_rate at 4 decimals is actually rounded to 2 first — minor precision loss for conversion_rate in performance_split.stats.
server.py: `spend_by_region` is returned but the Dashboard only uses `revenue_by_region`/`roas_by_region` — unused payload.
No hardcoded URLs/credentials; env vars used correctly; CORS configured.
Dashboard.jsx is ~445 lines — below the 700 threshold but trending long; splitting each TabsContent into its own component would improve maintainability.
All interactive elements expose data-testid per spec; filter popover content could also add data-testid='filter-option-<name>' for more stable option selectors in future tests.
seed_data_creation: None — tests operate on real xlsx dataset (1000 rows) loaded by backend at startup.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_ppc_api.py (pytest, 11 tests). Public API URL is REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL. Key selectors: dashboard-root, filter-bar, filter-count, filter-reset, filter-platforms (and analog for regions/ages/content/genders), tab-{insights,roas,geo,cpc,trends,correlation}, kpi-{campaigns,avg-roas,avg-cpc,revenue,spend}. Filter popover options are rendered as clickable divs (not role=checkbox) — select by visible text (e.g. get_by_text('Google', exact=True)). Escape closes popover. Dataset = 1000 rows, date_min=2024-02-10, date_max=2025-02-09.
